name: Hilbert Museum of California Art
tagline: California Scene paintings, Disney animation art & Millard Sheets mosaics
description: Established by Mark and Janet Hilbert at Chapman University and expanded in 2024 to 22,000 square feet, the Hilbert Museum is the only museum in the nation dedicated to the California Scene painting movement (1920s–1970s). Spanning 26 luminous galleries across from the historic Orange Depot, the museum features rotating exhibitions of American illustration, the monumental 40-foot Millard Sheets glass mosaic 'Pleasures Along the Beach', and an extraordinary permanent collection of original Disney and Hollywood studio animation art.
historicNote: Located adjacent to the historic 1938 Santa Fe Depot / Orange Metrolink Station in Old Towne's historic packing district, the museum showcases over a century of California everyday social history, working-class industries, coastal scenes, and Hollywood's golden age animation artistry.
